nuxt_group_status.reason: The __NUXT_DATA__ inline-JSON extraction method documented from the 2026-07-29 probe no longer applies. As of today the script tag id="__NUXT_DATA__" carries only a data-src attribute (e.g. /sports/football/schedule/_payload.json?<uuid>) instead of resolved flattened-array JSON in its body. Fetching that linked _payload.json returns a near-empty stub: [{"data":1,"prerenderedAt":-1},["ShallowReactive",2],{}] - no opponent/date/tv fields. The server-rendered HTML body itself only contains Vue 'skeleton-loader' placeholder divs for the schedule table (class c-schedulepage, data-test-id schedule-page__root etc.), confirming the actual game rows are populated client-side by JavaScript after page load, which curl cannot execute. This is a genuine site behavior change, not a robots/WAF block: HTTP 200 was returned throughout, no Incapsula challenge page or 403 appeared.

merge_note_20260731: Boise State, Colorado State, Fresno State and Oregon State re-pulled from their own sites via browser (rank 1). Oregon State's site carries NO TV network for any game; those cells are backfilled from Wikipedia at rank 2 and labelled as such. See source-ranks rule on silence vs denial.
